long_biography.plain_text:
Schwarz-Schütte joined the pharmaceutical company founded by his father and grandfather after training at Hoechst, studying business administration and working in consulting. He entered Schwarz Pharma after consulting, became chief executive in 1992 and led its 1995 flotation. Under his leadership, the company grew into an international drugmaker before the founding family agreed to sell its controlling stake to UCB.

After leaving the pharmaceutical group, he established Black Horse Investments as the family's investment office. Real estate became a central operating focus, spanning landmark commercial properties and mixed-use urban development in Düsseldorf. Schwarz-Schütte remains a managing shareholder and property developer, with recent projects retaining his co-investment after institutional sales. His career therefore joins transferred family ownership, hands-on pharmaceutical management and a later shift into long-term investment stewardship.
